lines.trans: Hello, I came here for an important interview.
Who are you and how did you get in here?
I brought my résumé for the head chef.
What are you even doing in my office?
Another cook said that the chef is already here.
The real head chef of this restaurant is me!
That person already hired me for the job.
Who dared hire you without my permission?
I dream of cooking delicious dishes in the kitchen.
Only I command here and no one else.
Please, give me one small chance.
Fine, now we will test your real culinary skills.

meanings.note: как попасть в центр? = how do I get to the centre?

examples.trans: A firework hit the power station.
How do I get to the station?

meanings.note: + infinitive; как ты посмел? = how dare you?

examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.
